WITH qualified AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
per_patient AS (
  SELECT l.ID,
         AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
         AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_diff
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN qualified q ON q.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_of_pt_averages,
       AVG(avg_tat_diff) AS avg_of_tat_diff_averages
FROM per_patient
